checks.detail: 4 packets with output schema and review questions

packets.title: FaithJudge: Evaluating Intrinsic and Extrinsic Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
pressure_points: citation supports fact but not conclusion
packets.required_resolution: Confirm whether FaithJudge evaluates conclusion-level support or only retrieved-context faithfulness and hallucination detection.
packets.required_boundary_change: Keep citation novelty limited to conclusion-support overreach rather than span attribution or hallucination detection.
review_questions: Does this source benchmark the same hard-grounded category, or only adjacent RAG/QA behavior?
Which manuscript claims must cite, narrow, or remove this source before final submission?
Does the source include executable data, metrics, or review protocol that overlaps this benchmark?
Does it test conclusion-level support, or only attribution/span/context faithfulness?
acceptance_criteria: Source has been read or explicitly ruled out with date and reason.
Impacted manuscript claims are updated in the paper claim ledger or marked unchanged with justification.
Evidence registry action is recorded before novelty_audit_final can pass.
Final disposition is one of: cite_and_narrow, cite_no_overlap, out_of_scope, subsumes_claim_remove_claim.
